title: Axes

# Axes

# Introduction

Axes are a weapon class.
They are the only type of player weapon that can be used to cut trees. They can also be used against creatures, which makes for a slightly worse sword.
Battleaxes have enough reach to attack through some walls, enabling the player to hit enemies on the other side of barriers. They can even hit The Queen through the wall in the vestibule inside the Infested Citadel, making for a more efficient cheese victory than even the Demolisher.

## List of axes

All axes are also able to chop Scorched trees found in Ashlands.

## Properties

• Attack type: Axes (primary) | Stamina: 1x | Range: 2.2m | Attack speed: 2.58 s (0.96 + 0.8 + 0.82) | Attack speed (trees): 1.3 s | Damage: 1x + 1x + 2x | Staggering: 1x | Knockback: 50–60 | Notes: Player moves forward 0.25m on the 2nd and 3rd combo swing. 90 degree arc.
